The Ordovician ( / ɔːr d ə ˈ v ɪ ʃ i . ə n , - d oʊ -, - ˈ v ɪ ʃ ən / or-də- VISH -ee-ən, -⁠doh-, -⁠ VISH -ən ) [ 8 ] is a geologic period and system , the second of six periods of the Paleozoic Era , and the second of twelve periods of the Phanerozoic Eon . The Ordovician spans 43.75 million years from the end of the Cambrian Period 486.85 Ma (million years ago) to the start of the Silurian Period 443.1 Ma. [ 9 ]
